news.headline: FLOOD WATCH — NWS Melbourne: Flood Watch for Orange, Osceola, Seminole, Volusia, Brevard & most of east-central Florida through Fri Nov 20 7 PM — 3–6 in. of rain, isolated 8–12 in.; Flood Warning continues for St. Johns River near Cocoa at major flood stage (NWS statement Wed 8:57 AM), high surf / rip-current risk through Friday

U.S. housing starts rose 9.9% in October to 1.309 million annual rate, beating forecasts — single-family starts up 4.0% to 864,000 — but building permits plunged 7.4% to 1.295 million, lowest since May 2020, with single-family permits down 8.7% to 772,000
Builder confidence fell 4 points to 25 in November — lowest since April 2012 — NAHB/Wells Fargo HMI; 46% of builders cut prices, buyer traffic fell to 16

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; Miami-Dade portal cutoff is 4 PM Dec 30, with new flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules
Copper tumbled below $13,000 Wed — LME 3-month fell 5.4% in midmorning U.S. trading to $12,505.50/ton, lowest since April, amid strong dollar, China demand concerns and AI-stock selloff
Leap Partners acquires Crowther Heating & Air Conditioning in Kilmarnock, VA — its second Virginia acquisition in two months; 37 HVAC, plumbing and electrical companies acquired in four years

Markets Wed midday look-ahead: futures rose after Nvidia beat — Nasdaq 100 futures +0.8%, S&P 500 futures +0.4% after Tue's 4th straight decline (S&P −1.03% to 7,340.53); October FOMC minutes due today 2 PM ET, Fed funds held at 3.75–4.00%, markets price ~95% chance of a Dec hike
Florida workers' comp: Commissioner Yaworsky approved NCCI's −7.4% average rate cut for new and renewal policies from Jan 1, 2027 — 11th straight year of reductions
NBA: Heat host Milwaukee Bucks tonight Wed 7 PM ET on ESPN; last out Mon — Magic 115, Celtics 105 (Bane 24 pts, Orlando's 4th straight win) · Heat 128, Rockets 110 (Miami's 5th straight win)

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Dolphins at Bills 1 PM ET, Buccaneers at Lions 1 PM ET, Jaguars at Giants 4:25 PM ET; Week 12 flex: Titans at Jaguars moves to 1 PM Sun Nov 29, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 8:15 PM on ESPN
